Caliverse: Calisthenics for Everyone

Calisthenics for the whole universe - this is our mission, and this is Caliverse. We believe in giving everyone a chance to explore bodyweight training and learn to perform exercises correctly using natural movements - no gym required!

Why Caliverse?

•	Train Anywhere, Anytime
Skip the gym and equipment. Harness the power of your bodyweight to work out wherever you choose.

•	Progress Faster with Professional Routines
Choose from 40+ training plans and hundreds of pre-built workouts, designed to help you build strength, mobility, and endurance.

•	Lower Injury Risk
Focus on functional, bodyweight movements to build strength naturally and reduce strain on joints and ligaments.

•	Full Workout Freedom
500+ exercises let you customize every aspect of your training. Build your own routines or modify existing ones to fit your schedule and goals.

•	Monthly Challenges
Join regular challenges to test your limits and stay motivated. Earn bragging rights or prizes by making it to the finish line.

•	Thrive in a Supportive Community
Share progress, swap tips, and connect with like-minded athletes. Whether you’re a beginner or advanced, find encouragement at every stage.

Free vs. Premium

Free Version Includes

•	Over 200 bodyweight workouts and 500+ (and growing!) exercises with detailed videos and descriptions.

•	Access to all the base training plans, monthly challenges with prizes, and our passionate community.

(We believe those who can’t afford a subscription should still have everything needed to progress.)

Caliverse Premium

•	Advanced and progressive workout plans targeting specific skills or movements, plus new premium plans added every month.

•	Follow-along video workouts for anytime, anywhere training.

•	Comprehensive tutorials on calisthenics, exercises, and technique.

•	Access all challenges without limitations—compete, stay consistent, and win valuable prizes.

•	Apple Health integration: Sync your workouts to close your rings and track overall activity.

Terms

By using Caliverse you accept our Terms of Use (https://www.caliverse.app/terms-of-use) and Privacy Policy (https://www.caliverse.app/privacy-policy). Find License Agreement here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

Get Started

Download Caliverse now and join a growing community of fitness enthusiasts. Reach your goals, stay motivated, and redefine what’s possible with bodyweight training!

Contact us at info@caliverse
